archetypes.name: schema-migration-compat
archetypes.rationale: Plan bumps write-run-params.sh schema_version 2→3 and says 'audit during implementation' for readers — that deferred audit is a plan gap that needs concrete evidence now.
archetypes.prompt_body: Locate every script under scripts/ and skills/design/scripts/ that reads run-params.json or calls read-design-classification.sh. For each, check whether it hard-codes schema_version == 2 or otherwise rejects unknown schema versions; if so, the plan's 'accept >= 2' instruction has no concrete fix step and the schema bump will break existing consumers. Verify the plan's test-write-run-params.sh additions actually include a backward-compat round-trip test (caller passes only the original five flags, asserts schema_version 3 JSON with new fields null). Check whether the plan's Optional A jq invocation correctly emits integer (not string) for sketch_budget when the flag is omitted — the null-vs-missing distinction is load-bearing for Step 2a's default logic. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: linter-pattern-gap
archetypes.rationale: Both new linters depend on grep-pattern precision; the plan names several syntax variants (ANSI-C escapes, heredoc bodies, array indexing) that must not false-positive but are not all covered by named test fixtures.
archetypes.prompt_body: For lint-renderer-substitution-safety.sh, verify the plan's detection regex distinguishes ${VAR//pat/$'\n'} (ANSI-C, safe) from ${VAR//pat/$file_derived} (unsafe) — the plan claims it does but does not show the regex. Check whether the plan includes a fixture for the array-indexing variant ${VAR//pat/$arr[0]} it mentions. For lint-skill-md-flag-signature.sh, verify the plan's continuation-line handling (flags on lines ending with backslash) is described precisely enough to implement without ambiguity, and that the harness includes a multi-line invocation fixture. Confirm the plan gates both linters on pass_filenames: false in pre-commit and that the scope (skills/**/*.md vs skills/*/SKILL.md) is consistent across the Makefile, pre-commit hook, and linter argv docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: silent-fallback-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan converts one 'default to HARD on failure' branch to a loud abort but does not audit whether the same silent-fallback pattern exists in other SKILL.md recovery paths or sibling scripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search skills/design/SKILL.md for all recovery/fallback branches (patterns like 'default to', 'fallback', 'set in-memory defaults', 'continue' after a non-zero exit) beyond the single Step 0b block the plan targets. For each, determine whether the plan's fix leaves them in the same silent-downgrade shape, and whether the acceptance criteria mention them. Also check the recovery-path write-run-params.sh call site (SKILL.md lines 334-344 per the issue) — the plan says 'the recovery-path call site is preserved unchanged' but if that second call site still passes the five defunct flags, the linter added in Section C will flag it on every run, creating a post-merge regression. Verify the plan explicitly handles both call sites, not just the primary. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
